findings.title: Wait for the reader to finish before checking its exceptions
findings.body: Setting deletedAll does not wait for an in-flight groups() request to finish. The assertion can therefore observe an empty caughtExceptions list and pass before the reader records an error from the final concurrent-deletion request. Retain the reader thread and join it before inspecting caughtExceptions so the regression test cannot miss those failures.

findings.title: Stop the reader even when a deletion fails
findings.body: If any group remove() call throws, execution skips deletedAll.set(true), leaving the newly started non-daemon thread repeatedly issuing requests indefinitely. It can continue accessing the realm and admin client after test teardown and interfere with subsequent tests or prevent the test process from exiting normally. Ensure the stop flag is set in a finally block and the worker is terminated before leaving the test.
